traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Selaginellaceae: erect, sprawling, tufted, creeping and rooting or climbing moss-like plants whose stems fork in pairs, sometimes into frond-like sprays; leaves scale-like, either all alike in spirals or of two sizes in four ranks; sporangia in terminal cones.

generator.params.note: Spikemosses sprawl, creep and root, or are tufted, many of them moss-like (Mabberley 2017, under Selaginellaceae): a clump is a dense mat of many stems that lean far out from it, their leaves stand out flatter and their strobili are short. The values are set by eye.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, 90, family Selaginellaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral; read as "spiral".

traits.leaf_division.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, 90, family Selaginellaceae: leaf division simple, sessile, small; read as "simple".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, 90, family Selaginellaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.sporangia.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, 90, family Selaginellaceae: sporangia cones (terminal strobili, sporophylls in 4 rows); read as "cones".

traits.reproduction.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 91, family Selaginellaceae: reproduction spores; read as "spores".
